checks.name: Workspace component tests (cook and finance payment screens)

scenario_results.observed: PaymentReconciliationIntegrationTest on PostgreSQL: deposits are not offered until finance staff with recent MFA approve the kitchen's recipient (cook 403, finance without recent MFA 403; audit payment.recipient_approve); a changed recipient returns to NONE and needs a new approval. A mismatch report without the amount seen is refused 422; another kitchen's cook gets 404; NOT_RECEIVED moves the payment to DISPUTED and it appears in the finance queue (cook 403 on the queue); staff cannot record RECEIVED (refused) and cannot decide while the order is active (409). Ops-web tests: the cook reports receipt or a problem and the screen never says bank confirmation; finance approves an account and decides an ended order with no 'received' option.

After the kitchen reports receipt of 13500 and then rejects the order, the payment is RECONCILE_PENDING; a decision without a reason is refused; finance records REFUND_OWED with a reason (audit payment.decision) and the customer's order view shows REFUND_OWED; a refund report without a reference is refused; with a reference the kitchen's report moves it to REFUNDED; the append-only payment timeline ends REFUND_OWED then REFUNDED and the order stays REJECTED. Limits: no automatic support case or customer notification on a dispute or refund obligation yet (recorded follow-up).

findings: MB-052 server part and screens (9e3ed88), evidence at the commit below. Self-review, not independent review. Follow-ups: automatic support case and customer notification for DISPUTED/REFUND_OWED. Live money remains blocked by D16 gates.
